v1.feedback: The Kusama dot-pattern parent is clearly preserved and the selcouth twist — slow spiral distortion plus ~12% of dots detaching and floating off the surface — is a legible, uncanny morph that reads as 'the parent after the word passed through it.' The indigo-on-spectral-pale palette with teal iridescence is restrained and earthy-strange. Two things to push: the concentric ring layout means the outer copies are tiny and don't contribute much beyond visual noise at the edges — tightening the rings or dropping the outermost would keep the frame denser; and the detachment effect is subtle enough that it can read as jitter rather than intentional levitation — increase detachDist or give detached particles a distinct size bump so the selcouth uncanniness is readable within the first two seconds.

v2.feedback: The Kusama polka-dot identity carries through clearly and the selcouth twist — spiral distortion plus ~15% particle detachment — reads as a genuine mutation of the parent rather than a fresh start. The indigo-on-pale palette with teal iridescence is restrained and earthy-strange, which fits 'selcouth' well. Two things to tighten: the detached particles wander a bit aimlessly and could benefit from more coherent drift paths (e.g. biased upward or along the twist axis) so the ghostliness feels intentional rather than noisy; and the polka-dot floor, while on-brand, competes with the figure — consider fading it more aggressively with distance or dropping its opacity so the Lucy silhouette commands more of the eye.
